summary: Phase 13 — Platform Module Registry (12 platforms) + ARISE Admissions + sidebar gating + ModuleGate. Backend: 9/9 tests PASS covering catalog, VCE per-tenant (6 active + 6 coming_soon), PATCH disable/re-activate with persistence, cross-tenant 403, non-admin 403, dependency 409 (COMPASS blocked when NEXUS disabled), invalid status 400, unknown module 404, super_admin cross-tenant write. Frontend: 100% of 13 critical flows verified end-to-end as principal@vaagdevi.edu.in and manikanta.cse@vaagdevi.edu.in.
action_items: (Nit, testability) Rank-predictor bars currently use data-testid='arise-predict-{CODE}' (e.g. arise-predict-CSE). The Phase-13 brief asked for 'arise-branch-prob-*'. The 7 branches render correctly and CSE(6%) < ECE(57%) for rank 12500 — only the testid naming differs. Either accept the existing scheme or rename to match brief; downstream tests should target 'arise-predict-{CODE}'.

(Nit, testability) Pipeline columns use data-testid='arise-col-{stage}' (not 'pipeline-col-{stage}' as I initially guessed). Capture flow verified visually: Test Lead +91 99999 00000 / CSE / rank 4500 / EAPCET counselling -> appeared in NEW column with score 94 (>=80) and 'drip campaign' toast.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_modules.py: dependency check correctly walks depends_on and uses the current row OR catalog default — clean. Returns 409 with descriptive detail.

routes_modules.py: PATCH writes both platform_modules upsert AND audit_logs row with stable id pattern — good. Consider using a deterministic id (e.g. f'audit-{uuid4()}') instead of timestamp-derived; under high concurrency two requests in same microsecond could collide.
routes_modules.py GET list_for_tenant: hydrates absent rows from PLATFORM_CATALOG defaults — sidebar therefore works for tenants with zero rows seeded. Good.

ModuleGate flow verified: disabling ARISE -> /admissions renders module-gate with 'Open Platform Modules' CTA and shows correct message 'Your Institution Admin has disabled the ARISE module for VCE.' Re-activating restores both sidebar entry and the admissions-page.
Sidebar correctly filters items by status; ILLUMINATE (coming_soon) shows the 'Soon' pill on Content Studio and Assessments as expected.
Read-only mode for student on /admin/modules works: page renders with a 'Read-only' badge, zero mod-status-* dropdowns are present — clean role gating in PlatformModules.jsx.

Sidebar refetch after PATCH: works without manual navigation in this environment — useTenantModules picks up the new status when the user lands back on '/' from /admin/modules. The agent-to-agent context note about needing a hard refresh did not reproduce in this test run.
test_credentials: Used principal@vaagdevi.edu.in / Demo@2026 (institution_admin), manikanta.cse@vaagdevi.edu.in / Demo@2026 (student), admin@academiaos.ai / Admin@2026 (super_admin). All from /app/memory/test_credentials.md, all working.
seed_data_creation: Created one ARISE lead 'Test Lead' (+91 99999 00000, CSE, rank 4500, source EAPCET counselling) in VCE pipeline during UI test. Module flips (ARISE disable/enable, NEXUS disable/enable, COMPASS disable/enable, ISB ARISE) all restored to seeded 'active' state at end of tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 13 is solid green. Useful selectors for follow-up work: sidebar entries use data-testid='sidebar-nav-{kebab}' and coming_soon pill is 'sidebar-soon-{CODE}'. Platform Modules page is '/admin/modules', testid 'platform-modules-page'; rows are 'mod-row-{CODE}'; admin dropdown is 'mod-status-{CODE}' (absent for non-admin roles — page renders in read-only mode). ARISE admissions page uses 'admissions-page', 'arise-name/phone/email/branch/rank/source/submit', 'arise-predict-rank', branch bars 'arise-predict-{CODE}' (CSE,AIML,DS,ECE,EEE,CIV,MECH), pipeline columns 'arise-col-{new|counseled|applied|enrolled}', lead cards 'arise-lead-{id}'. Module gate uses 'module-gate' testid.
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA. Two minor testid naming mismatches between Phase-13 brief and code (arise-branch-prob-* vs arise-predict-*, pipeline-col-* vs arise-col-*) — functional behaviour matches the brief, only the testid strings differ.
